title: GOD'S GOODNESS - THE FULL ARMOUR OF GOD'S WISDOM

blocks.text: “In this special writing we would like to discuss God’s goodness in healing the body, soul and mind, and giving one peace and prosperity! First a person should have the proper outlook and think positive on what the Lord has promised!” – “As a man thinketh in His heart so is he!” (Prov. 23:7) – “Here is another Scripture that will bring you health and success and will improve your disposition!” (Ps. 51:10) “Renew a right spirit within me!”- “Also it will help you to acquire new acquaintances and your spiritual friends will admire you more!” – “Next, God has not given us an unsettled, worried or confused mind that leads to fear, but one of power, love and soundness!” (Read II Tim. 1:7) “World crises, perilous times and satan will try to shake the elect even more so at the end, but Jesus gives you the proper medicine and a real good prescription, Isa. 26:3, “Thou will keep him in perfect peace, whose mind (thoughts) is stayed on thee! – Because he trusteth in thee!” How? Simple child-like faith, you rest in His Word, settle forever in your heart!” (Verse 4) – “He gives a confident heart! Don’t let your heart control you, but you control your heart by the help of the Holy Spirit! Also love overcomes fear! Practice this and it will cause the other things to diminish and your faith will grow!”

“Also ignore criticism, gossip and satan’s darts, put on the full armour of God’s wisdom, divine love and understanding! And provide the day with much praise and thanksgiving and you will be transformed by the renewing of your mind!” (Rom. 12:2) – “Happiness and joy belong to those who make it that way within themselves as they follow God’s spiritual instructions!” – “The Lord has commanded be strong, and of good courage, be not afraid, be neither thou dismayed!” (Josh.1:9) “Believe this in your heart and you will have the courage to overcome every difficulty! And it will rid you of negative feelings and give you a high voltage of tremendous power to command the promises of the Lord Jesus! – It’s the negative feelings in your heart that cause you to get less from God, but by practicing the Scriptures in this letter you will take on an active force of determined faith! – An actual possessing of magnetic power to bring God’s promises and rewards daily in your life!” – “In fact He says, don’t forget all of His benefits! (Ps. 103:2) Including salvation and healing! One can even have a renewing of their youth and divine health!” (Verse 5) – “Remember the kingdom of God is within you!” (Luke 17:21) “It’s up to you to activate this real source of power daily by praising Him!” – “Don’t worry about anything being against you or anyone that would even work against you, because if God be for us, who can be against us!” (Rom. 8:31) – “Also this letter is anointed in a powerful way to convince and give you the determination to receive and to do wonderful things for the Lord!” – “Paul says, rejoice, I say rejoice for ever more!” – “And as the Scriptures say, Be of good cheer!”

“Here are some amazing Scriptures denoting that faith is action! – To the centurion, go thy way; as thou has believed, so be it unto you!” (Matt. 8:13) – Matt 9:22, “daughter be of GOOD COMFORT; thy faith hath made thee whole!” – Matt. 9:29, “According to your faith be it unto you.” – Mark 10:52, “Go thy way; thy faith hath made thee whole!” – “To the woman who was a sinner and a prostitute, He said, Thy faith has saved thee; go in peace!” (Luke 7:50) – “He also did the same thing for Mary Magdalene! He gave them rest and a contented mind, and their torment fled them!” To another case He said, “O woman great is thy faith: be it unto thee even as thou wilt!” (Matt. 15:28) – “In other words unlimited potentials were before her!” – “To the leper, arise, go thy way: thy faith has made thee whole!” (Luke 17:19)

“Now we see the potentials of faith combined with action is unlimited!” – “Jesus said, All things are possible to him that believeth!” (Mark 9:23) – Matt. 17:20, “By faith nothing shall be impossible! – Luke 17:6, “By faith even nature and the elements will obey you! And if need be, He will remove a mountain for you!” (Mark 11:22-23) – “By faith whatsoever you desire you may have!” (Verse 24) – “And by faith thou shalt see the glory of God!” (St. John 11:40) – “Also Jesus gives us authority over ALL the power of the enemy!” (Luke 10:19) – “By now you should be feeling the energy of the Holy Spirit super charging you to be more than a conqueror! As Paul said, Behold, I can do ALL things through Christ Jesus!” – “If ye shall ask anything in my name I will do it!” (John 14:12-14) – “These Scriptures will provide a wonderful secret, that you and I can do the same works that He did by faith. And if and when tests and trials appear, remember this, trust in the Lord with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine OWN understanding!” (Prov. 3:5) – “In other words, in calm faith wait in His presence and He will work out all things that confront you!” – “As you practice these things happiness will work its way into your life and many of your prayers will be answered!” – “And also the angel of the Lord will encamp around where obedience and faith are working!” (Ps. 34:7)

“As the Holy Spirit moves on me I definitely feel led to write this Scripture here, Ps. 37:4-5, “DELIGHT thyself also in the Lord: and He shall give thee the DESIRES of thine heart, COMMIT thy way unto the Lord; trust also in Him; and He shall bring it to pass!” – “And now one important and final word to really Capstone this message, because it is part of the foundation to cause all the promises of God to work for your good and well being!” – Luke 6:38, “Give and it shall be given unto you!” – “Thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success!” (Josh. 1:8) – “The Lord shall open unto thee His good treasure!” (Deut. 28:12) – “The blessing of the Lord, it maketh rich!” (Prov. 10:22) – “The Lord shall command a blessing upon thee in all that thou settest thy hand unto!” (Deut. 28:8) – “Give and thou shalt have treasure in heaven!” (Matt. 19:21) – “Thou shall remember the Lord thy God: for it is He that giveth thee power to get wealth!” (Deut. 8:18) – Mal. 3:10, “Prove me now! – and He is obligated to open up to you the windows of heaven and pour you out a blessing!” – “The Lord Jesus never forces anyone to give more than they really want to, but most of all He loves a generous and a cheerful giver!” – “And by giving this causes people to begin to put their faith into definite action!” – “The Bible confirms it, God’s law guarantees that ‘you reap’ more than you sow in blessings!” – “Let’s conclude all of these wonderful promises in one Scripture, “As a man thinketh in his heart so is he!” (Prov. 23:7)
